Portfolio

Lucky Blue Smith began his modeling career at just 10 years old. Though it was his striking and conventional good looks that got him noticed, it has been his chameleon quality that has ushered him to the next echelon. An iconic “it boy,” and at one time a viral social media sensation, fans marvel at his ability to transition across bad boy, pretty boy, and the boy next door. Beyond appearance, however, Smith has proved his professional versatility by walking runways for the likes of Versace, Dolce and Gabbana, and Marc Jacobs; gracing the covers of hundreds of fashion magazines; appearing in high-profile advertising campaigns for legendary names like Tom Ford, Calvin Klein, and Tommy Hilfiger; and pursuing a career in acting. Today, Smith works with brands in the traditional and digital realm and will continue to appear in upcoming films in 2025.
